tldr: North Node in aquarius: growth through community, future vision, shared systems, and principled difference.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop community, future vision, shared systems, and principled difference. The South Node in leo shows the familiar route: needing to be special, dramatizing recognition, or centering the self in every room. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to bring your gifts into a larger future.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices community, future vision, shared systems, and principled difference in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in leo can pull the person back into needing to be special, dramatizing recognition, or centering the self in every room.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
